title: St Nazaire: The Warship That Became a Time Bomb

scenes.headline: FLOATING TIME BOMB
scenes.text: This destroyer exploded hours after its crew rammed a dock gate.

scenes.headline: WHY THIS GATE?
scenes.text: Why sacrifice a warship just to destroy a dock gate?

scenes.headline: 28 MAR 1942
scenes.text: On March twenty-eighth, nineteen forty-two, Britain targeted Saint-Nazaire in occupied France.

scenes.headline: TIRPITZ'S REPAIR OPTION
scenes.text: Its dry dock was the only one on France's Atlantic coast big enough for Tirpitz.

scenes.headline: HIDDEN CHARGES
scenes.text: Around six hundred commandos and sailors attacked. Campbeltown carried hidden explosives and delayed fuses.

scenes.headline: RAMMING SPEED
scenes.text: At around one thirty-four that morning, the destroyer rammed the gate.

scenes.headline: SAME MORNING
scenes.text: Hours later that same morning, Germans were inspecting the wreck.

scenes.headline: OUT OF ACTION
scenes.text: The dock stayed unusable for the rest of the war.

scenes.headline: REPAIR OPTION LOST
scenes.text: It helped keep Tirpitz from raiding the Atlantic.

scenes.headline: WORTH THE COST?
scenes.text: Was destroying that dock worth the cost in ships and lives?
